comments.author: @michaeld6262
comments.text:
I really like this video but I think there was so much repetition about why people are capped at 400 permanent residents, and only 400 people can come to visit at any time, etc. etc. etc. 

I believe this video could’ve been shortened quite a bit if it got to the point which, was mentioned earlier in the video. The point was the finding of the stick insect, which looks almost kind of like a praying mantis. 

I don’t know if this video was meant to be a tourist invitation. I got a feeling that they just needed to make a long video no matter how many times they had to repeat the same information. I’m 80 years old and I love the history of the world and I’m not really stupid and I don’t really think that I like to keep hearing the same information over and over. 

😊Just musing, I’m just saying I think the video could’ve been a lot shorter and they could have gotten to the point and showed all of the scenery in at least 15 minutes.

replies.author: @themaps26
replies.text: Thanks for the honest feedback! Glad you liked the video overall. We'll definitely keep an eye on pacing and script structure to avoid repeating points in future videos.
